description: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm harness compiled against the human-authored Ionspin BigNum 0.3.10 arbitrary-precision arithmetic library, exercising integer, decimal, modular, parsing, square-root, power, division, and gcd code paths.
notes: Built as an optimized Kotlin/Wasm WASI library fixture. The exported score functions intentionally fold richer library results into i32 values so the corpus runner can assert behavior without requiring string return support.
